Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Updates (coverage_matrix.csv XLSX Tab 'Updates', 2.49 grab-bag section) > post-run cleanup for 'Prompted Update Scenario 1/2' (flows/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_01_ill_update_later.yaml, prompted_update_scenario_02_forced_commcare_update.yaml). Restores '[Master] Basic Tests NS Copy' (app_id below, same app setup_02_commcare_version_plus_one.json and prompted_update_scenario_02_forced.json mutate) back to a neutral Manage Update Settings state: apk_prompt/app_prompt back to 'off' (no prompt pending for the next flow that logs into this app) and apk_version back to the ACTUAL release under test this run, not left pointing at the dev/pre-release build scenario_02's forced-transition needs.

Per direct user instruction (2026-08-24): this app_id is shared with other updates_2_49 flows (auto_cc_update_03_relogin_sync_latest_version.yaml, auto_cc_update_daily_preset.json) that assume no update is pending and a normal target version - same 'shared, persistent HQ state' concern scripts/run_appium_prompted_updates_suite.py's own finally-block cleanup already handles for '[Master] Basic Tests' on the Prompted Updates tab (see that file's own citation for why cleanup must retry rather than give up on one transient failure).

apk_version's '$CURRENT_APK_VERSION' is a run_pre_step()/hq_client.py sentinel, substituted with whatever CommCare release scripts/run_suite.py actually resolved+dispatched THIS run (its own apk_commcare_version, from download_apk.resolve()) - never hand-edit it to a literal version, it would go stale immediately.

Run via `python scripts/run_suite.py --tag updates_2_49 --hq-setup hq_setup/updates_2_49/setup_02_commcare_version_plus_one.json --hq-teardown hq_setup/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_teardown.json` (teardown runs in a finally block - always, even if the flows themselves fail) - or standalone via `python scripts/hq_client.py hq_setup/updates_2_49/prompted_update_scenario_teardown.json` with APK_VERSION_OVERRIDE... no such flag exists for the standalone CLI path, so prefer the run_suite.py --hq-teardown path; a standalone run leaves apk_version as the literal string '$CURRENT_APK_VERSION' unresolved (hq_client.py's CLI entrypoint never supplies current_apk_version) and will fail loudly in run_pre_step rather than silently write a bogus value.
